question: What share of the 0.1C reversible capacity is retained at 1C?

trace.query: SELECT id, page, text, region FROM lines WHERE text ILIKE '%0.1C%' OR text ILIKE '%1C%' OR text ILIKE '%retention%' OR text ILIKE '%rate%' ORDER BY page, line_no
SELECT id, figure_id, text FROM figure_ocr WHERE text ILIKE '%0.1%' OR text ILIKE '%1C%' OR text ILIKE '%retain%' OR text ILIKE '%%' ORDER BY figure_id, line_no
SELECT id, text FROM lines WHERE page=5 AND line_no BETWEEN 55 AND 105 ORDER BY line_no

SELECT CAST(regexp_extract(a.text, '([0-9]+) mAh/gS at high', 1) AS DOUBLE) / CAST(regexp_extract(b.text, '\(([0-9]+) mAh', 1) AS DOUBLE) AS share FROM lines a, lines b WHERE a.id='p5.L87' AND b.id='p5.L79'
